page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical Intel Xeon 8369HB cores with hyper-threading enabled. Operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, the x86_64 processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache and supports advanced vector extensions such as AVX-512 and AVX-512_VNNI. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.hfr7.2xlarge in the average tier for most compute and memory operations. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1320.0 and a multi-core score of 5074.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 9658.56. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 465.34 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 51.09 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, with write speeds reaching 38.89 GB/sec. While static web serving throughput is stable at 7.65 GB/sec, database operations score 3169.42 on Passmark. However, Redis SET operations are weak at 7.99 million operations per second, and medium-sized 7B LLM inference speeds are poor, processing prompts at 11.93 tokens per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr7.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing power without resource contention. This profile is well-suited for memory-optimized applications such as medium-sized databases, caching layers, enterprise application servers, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
